notes: theme_data cases: input.files are paths relative to <HOME>/.config/omarchy/current (the service constants were re-pointed at a temp dir; real ~/.config never touched). 'theme <name>' cases: colors_toml is the omarchy theme's colors.toml (omarchy repo at omarchy_sha) and files['theme/alacritty.toml'] is what omarchy renders from default/themed/alacritty.toml.tpl via `omarchy-theme-color --all` (NOTE current omarchy writes to ~/.local/state/omarchy/current, not ~/.config/omarchy/current). Symlink values {symlink: '<THEMES>/x'} point into a sibling temp themes dir built from input.themes_dir_files. files value null = directory at that path ('/'-suffixed key). {mode: 0} = file chmod 000 (EACCES unless running as root). expected.available = OmarchyThemeService.available?; theme_data keys are symbols in Ruby (theme_name, variables, is_dark). Float results (relative_luminance, contrast_ratio) are Ruby Float -> JSON shortest round-trip repr.
